about:
Epsilon Apparel operates as a full-package apparel manufacturing house in Los Angeles, California. The company employs the Tukatech digital pattern, grading, and marking system to accelerate development and production workflows. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

The shop provides pattern making, grading, marking, sample development, and production cutting and sewing, along with production management and consulting services. Production runs start at 100 to 150 units per style, scaling with size and colorway complexity. The facility also maintains its own contemporary and activewear collections.

Clients include fashion brands, startups, and designers needing extra capacity during design transitions or overload periods. The company serves the fashion, contemporary apparel, and activewear segments, working within customer parameters to deliver finished garments.

Epsilon positions itself as a supplemental resource—"a few extra pairs of hands"—for critical phases of the apparel production process, emphasizing fast, accurate turnarounds through its digital tooling.
